title: [finding] `bin/run-dev.js` run from a cwd whose tsconfig maps `@objectstack/spec` to source fails to load the command set and blames a missing spec build that is present
body:
Filed unassigned from the #16095 blast-radius sweep (branch `claude/issue-16095-hook-rules-reach-handler-authored-hooks`), measured on `origin/main` @ `5d55afec4d` with a freshly built `packages/spec/dist` (`dist/data/index.js` and `index.d.ts` both export `DATABASE_DRIVER_SELECTION_IDS`).

## Reproduction

```
cd examples/app-multi-package            # or packages/plugins/plugin-security
../../node_modules/.bin/tsx ../../packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js lint objectstack.config.ts --json
```

exit 2, stderr:

```
Warning: SyntaxError  module: @oclif/core@4.13.3  task: findCommand (dev)  plugin: @objectstack/cli
message: The requested module '@objectstack/spec/data' does not provide an export named 'DATABASE_DRIVER_SELECTION_IDS'
objectstack: NOT A MISSING COMMAND — @oclif/core reports a command module that failed to LOAD as "not found" ...
objectstack: Fix: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/spec
Error: command lint:objectstack.config.ts not found
```

The same invocation from the repo root (`tsx packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js lint examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts --json`) exits 0 and lints the config. `plugin-security` shows the same shape with `@objectstack/types` / `ErrorCode`.

## Reading

Both cwd's carry a `tsconfig.json` whose `paths` map `@objectstack/spec` (and siblings) to `../../packages/spec/src/…` — the redirect #11094 described as "a latent runtime redirect for any tsx-honouring tool". tsx reads the cwd's tsconfig, so the CLI's own imports are re-routed to spec SOURCE, where the subpath's export set differs from `dist`, and every oclif command that imports the affected subpath fails to load. The dev entry's diagnostic then prescribes rebuilding spec, which is already built — the prescription is wrong for this cause.

Two observations, either of which would help: the diagnostic could check whether `packages/spec/dist` exists and is fresh before prescribing a rebuild, and name the cwd tsconfig redirect when it does; or `run-dev.js` could pin tsx's tsconfig to `packages/cli/tsconfig.json` regardless of cwd.

Impact: dev entry only (`bin/run-dev.js` via tsx); the built `bin/run.js` is unaffected. It did block measuring two of the ten in-tree configs from their own directories during #16095 — the root-anchored run was the workaround.

Related: #11094 (closed) · #12964 (closed, the same "command not found" masking on `i18n:extract`).
